question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT packaging_id, contains_id, qty, 1 as level
    FROM packaging_relations
    WHERE packaging_id IN (531, 532, 533, 534)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT h.packaging_id, pr.contains_id, h.qty * pr.qty, h.level + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.contains_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT p1.name as top_container_name, p2.name as item_name, SUM(h.qty) as total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p1 ON h.packaging_id = p1.id
JOIN packaging p2 ON h.contains_id = p2.id
GROUP BY h.packaging_id, h.contains_id, p1.name, p2.name
ORDER BY h.packaging_id, total_qty DESC
